title: Artisan Bread Without a Dutch Oven | Baking Steel Open Bake Method
ldName: 24-Hour Artisan Bread — Open Baked on a Baking Steel
ldKeywords: artisan bread, open baking, baking steel bread, artisan bread recipe, bread without dutch oven, lava rock steam bread
ldInstructionsRaw: Whisk dry ingredients together. Slowly add water and mix. Knead on countertop for 2-3 minutes. Cover and proof at room temperature for 10-12 hours.
Turn dough onto floured surface, fold into a ball, and let rest 30 minutes.
Fold dough again into a tight ball. Place seam-side up in floured banneton basket. Cover and refrigerate 10-12 hours.
Place Baking Steel on middle rack with lava rocks in pie pan on bottom. Preheat oven to 500°F for one hour. Remove dough from fridge.
Turn dough onto parchment paper and score the top with a lame or sharp knife.
Pour 1-1.5 cups cold water onto hot lava rocks. Slide bread onto Baking Steel and close oven immediately.
Bake 20 minutes at 500°F with steam. Remove lava rocks and reduce temperature to 425°F.
Bake 15-20 more minutes until deep golden brown and hollow-sounding when tapped.
Cool on wire rack at least 30 minutes before slicing.
htmlIngredientLines: 60g spelt flour — adds earthiness and a rustic texture. Skip it if you can't find it, but it's worth seeking out.
300g water — room temperature or slightly above. Use filtered if your tap water is heavily chlorinated — chlorine can slow down your yeast.
1.5g active dry yeast — that's about half a teaspoon. Less yeast = longer ferment = more flavor.
